verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents product search and lookup that agents can reach via MCP, including Claude and ChatGPT, plus buy URLs and affiliate sale attribution. Nothing in the pack shows buyers completing a checkout inside a chat or assistant surface, or any merchant-facing agent-checkout capability. Buy URLs and in-chat discovery are adjacent features, not in-chat purchase completion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)
